summary: Phase 3 testing complete. All 5 new features verified end-to-end: (1) voice selector w/ 8 voices + custom voice_id TTS, (2) Forge image generation (OpenAI GPT Image 1 + Gemini Nano Banana, both auto-add to forge with correct tags), (3) /api/system returns exactly 2 GPUs (RTX 4070 Super #1, RTX 3050; no #2), (4) Offline queue full CRUD + flush executes queued dispatches, (5) frontend UI: offline toggle, voice dropdown chevron, Forge generate form w/ provider toggle, draggable chain steps w/ INPUT->Agent->OUTPUT flow preview. 10/10 new backend pytest cases pass with real LLM (~41s). UI screenshot confirms drag handle, flow preview, and Hermes auto-selected in step 0 (iter2 nit fixed).

issues: Two 'ONLINE' indicators appear side-by-side in the top-right header (status pill + offline-toggle button). Consider merging into a single combined status/toggle control or relabeling the toggle to 'GO OFFLINE' when online to avoid visual redundancy.

action_items: (Optional UX) Deduplicate the 'ONLINE/ONLINE' twin badges in the header.
(Still applicable from iter2) Split server.py (now ~880 lines) into routers (agents, dispatches, voice, forge, queue, chains, plugins, mempalace, system).
(Still applicable) Migrate deprecated @app.on_event startup to FastAPI lifespan.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:404 /forge/generate - On Gemini path, if send_message_multimodal_response returns no images (e.g., safety filter), endpoint raises 500 'No image generated'. This is correct behavior but consider returning the gen_text/refusal reason in the error detail for easier debugging.

server.py:497 flush_queue - Executes dispatches sequentially with no per-item timeout; a single hung dispatch can block all subsequent ones and the request. Consider asyncio.wait_for per item or fire-and-forget background task pattern.
server.py:438 forge_doc tags = req.tags + ['ai-generated', req.provider] - no de-duplication; if user passes 'openai' as a tag, it appears twice. Minor.

server.py: Generated image stored as base64 data URL in MongoDB (can be 1-5 MB per item). With many generations, the /api/forge GET response will grow unbounded. Consider storing images on disk/S3 and returning URLs, or paginating /api/forge.

server.py:411 Gemini image gen uses model 'gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview' - verify this model id is still available; if changed upstream, the endpoint will 500. Add fallback or surface a clearer error.
server.py:758 /api/system uses random.randint each call - acceptable for a 'fake telemetry' panel but document this so consumers don't treat it as real GPU data.

success_rate.backend: 100% (10/10 phase3 + all previous suites assumed green)

seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_QUEUE_ITEM/TEST_QUEUE_DELETE/TEST_FLUSH queue items (all cleared by flush). 2 Forge items auto-added by image gen tests (1 OpenAI 'tiny red circle', 1 Gemini 'tiny blue square') - left in DB since they validate the auto-add-to-forge feature; main agent can delete via UI if cleanup desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3 fully verified. New test file: /app/backend/tests/test_phase3_features.py (10 tests, ~41s). Image gen tests use real EMERGENT_LLM_KEY and take 10-60s each (OpenAI gpt-image-1, Gemini gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview). UI testids: offline-mode-toggle, voice-speak-button (with chevron), voice-selector-dropdown, voice-option-{id}, voice-speak-selected, forge-generate-button, forge-generate-form, forge-gen-provider-openai/gemini, forge-gen-prompt, forge-gen-submit, chain-step-{i} (draggable=true), chain-step-agent-{i}, chain-step-prompt-{i}. Voice dropdown is gated behind speak-button being enabled (requires lastResponseRef or streamingText set) - to test the dropdown opening in playwright, run a dispatch first to populate lastResponseRef, then click the chevron part of voice-speak-button. ElevenLabs voices_read permission missing so /api/voice/voices returns the hardcoded 8-voice fallback list (which is the intended behavior per requirements).
rca of the issue: No issues found. All phase 3 features behave as specified.
